method: Chrome UI click to visible destination heading and first data row/card; includes automation overhead; three consecutive samples per surface; no device/network standardization

teacherLargeCourse.notes: Includes subsequent automatic exercise-route prefetch; this is not a 29-query SQL measurement.

limitations: One teacher readiness wait exceeded the browser tool deadline while auxiliary profiling was being prepared; page subsequently displayed normally. Its click-to-ready duration was not obtained, and it is not silently represented as a successful timing sample.
Large-course click-to-heading wait exceeded the tool deadline; request timing was obtained separately from Chrome Network.
Team-lead login was blocked before authentication by security-widget load error 300030. Student login was not attempted after that block.
No production load/capacity benchmark, deployment, course/class edits, submissions, grades or server configuration changes were performed. Normal sign-in/sign-out activity occurred.
